definitions.affine_candidate: the same RLE with every repeated run count normalized to 2+
definitions.carry_width: number of component hull intervals crossing a width-three packet boundary
definitions.continuation_behavior: complete normalized outgoing equality labels and accepting suffix-label language
definitions.event_word: canonical rooted component IDs with per-slot single/open/carry/close interval events, in consecutive packets of at most three face slots
definitions.run_length_candidate: RLE of anonymous packet event/carry symbols, retaining run counts
definitions.span: last minus first frontier occurrence plus one for each represented component
definitions.stack_depth: number of component hull intervals covering a face slot

limitations: Collision results use complete continuation behavior only at n=5 and n=8.
The n=11 and n=14 equality witnesses and n=17 control are single fixed traces, not complete corridors.
Anonymous packet motifs deliberately discard component identity and may collide.
No inference at unenumerated widths or for unobserved witnesses is claimed.

n5-complete-equality-corridor.selection: all unique states in all minimum paths
